# George Jieh — AI/ML Engineer & LLM Evaluation Specialist

> George Jieh is an AI/ML engineer and LLM evaluation specialist based in San Francisco. Former Scale AI Oracle Tier trainer and Quality Analyst across 12 RLHF training projects for frontier model labs. Builds production LLM pipelines, ML systems, and multi-agent orchestration.

## What I do

- LLM evaluation and RLHF training for frontier models (data plausibly used by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta, Microsoft)
- Production AI pipelines using Python, FastAPI, OpenAI API, and Ollama
- Machine learning with scikit-learn, PyTorch, H2O AutoML, and Keras
- Multi-agent orchestration across OpenAI Codex and Hermes Agent; MCP server design

## Selected work

- MachineRead — Public Website Audit: shipped public-readiness audit scoring websites for AI visibility, agent accessibility, scrapability, and search discovery. FastAPI + Next.js/TypeScript, 301-test suite, OpenAPI 3.1, MCP server, portable Agent Skill. https://github.com/georgejieh/MachineRead-Preview
- FreshRSS Financial News Analyzer: LLM inference pipeline for 24-hour financial news analysis with dual-prompt architecture and OpenAI/Ollama model routing. https://github.com/georgejieh/freshrss-ai-summarizer
- Wine Grape Climate Suitability Model: ML pipeline predicting grape varietal suitability from 60+ years of climate data; being rebuilt to production quality. https://github.com/georgejieh/predicting_grape_suitability_based_on_climate_and_precipitation
